'''2008 Oregon State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 23 August 2008 at Rainy Day Games, 18105 SW TV Hwy, Aloha, Oregon, with [[Steve Harpster]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-21070-326902">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=326902#326902 Oregon States], Chris Wirfs (itcouldbewirfs), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083823/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330749 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-21070-326901">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=326901#326901 Oregon States], Chris Wirfs (itcouldbewirfs), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083823/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330749 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Ryan Freeman]] won and took the bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]]; twelve players took part, six from Washington and six from Oregon.<ref name="pcf-21070-331188">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=331188#331188 Oregon States], Chris Wirfs (itcouldbewirfs), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083823/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330749 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Rainy Day Games, 18105 SW TV Hwy, Aloha, Oregon<ref name="pcf-21070-326901" />
* '''Dates:''' 23 August 2008<ref name="pcf-21070-326901" /><ref name="pcf-21070-326902" />
* '''Time:''' 11:00 am<ref name="pcf-21070-326902" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, under the Players Committee's Championship Level Event Rules; announced as four rounds and a final confrontation with fewer than eight players, or six rounds and no final confrontation with eight or more; decklists required<ref name="pcf-21070-326902" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5<ref name="pcf-21070-326902" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Harpster]], who also played; three-judge system with [[Chris Wirfs]] and one more player as judges<ref name="pcf-21070-326902" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Ryan Freeman]]<ref name="pcf-21070-331188" />

== Organization ==

Chris Wirfs posted the announcement on 16 August 2008 and confirmed the date as official ("this is official").<ref name="pcf-21070-326901" /><ref name="pcf-21070-326902" /> The first-place prize was a bye into Day 2 of the World Championship; other prizes depended on the number of entries.<ref name="pcf-21070-326902" />

== Results ==

Wirfs posted the official results on 26 August 2008. Freeman and DJ Tobey finished first and second, and Tobey conceded the final confrontation to Freeman.<ref name="pcf-21070-331188" /> Freeman played BHBM Dueling and Farming, according to a post by CategoryOneGames.com, which also wrote that he had won the 2007 Utah state championship.<ref name="pcf-21070-330667">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330667#330667 Oregon States], CategoryOneGames.com, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083823/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330749 Internet Archive]</ref>
